integrity.arithmetic_basis: The proof factors the divisor sum prime by prime and uses the exact two-adic lifting-the-exponent identity only when an odd-prime exponent is odd.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for alg-geom/9711035 is dated 1997-11-28.
integrity.geometric_formula_basis: Debarre's Corollary 3.7 gives the Euler characteristic as the cube of the Hilbert-scheme length times its divisor sum; Gulbrandsen and Shen independently restate the same abelian-surface formula.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: Bibliographic classification for Debarre's paper includes 14F45 and 14J28; the work is algebraic geometry of generalized Kummer varieties.

scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary topological Euler characteristic is treated; refined cohomological invariants are not covered.
The exact dyadic statement is an arithmetic consequence of the classical generalized-Kummer Euler formula, so unindexed prior occurrence remains possible.
Higher-dimensional generalized Kummer schemes attached to abelian varieties of dimension greater than two are outside the theorem.
title: Exact dyadic valuation of generalized Kummer Euler characteristics
